DUME.purpose: The commissioning harness source. Control-plane changes are separate work, never a side effect of a target work package.

SPEC_MOUNT.purpose: The authoritative specification for whatever DUM-E is pointed at. Read-only to every build agent, so a package cannot rewrite the requirement it is failing. UNBOUND until a human binds it with the bind_workspace action.

BUILD_TARGET.purpose: The implementation under construction. Written only through an assigned worktree, never directly. UNBOUND until a human binds it with the bind_workspace action.

EVIDENCE.purpose: Commissioning receipts. Prior failed evidence is never destroyed by a retry.

MODEL_CACHE.purpose: Model weights, outside Git. Root filesystem cannot hold them.

notes: JSON rather than TOML/YAML: the host runs Python 3.10 (no stdlib tomllib) and the DUM-E foundation must have zero third-party dependencies. SPEC_MOUNT and BUILD_TARGET ship unbound: a slot that grants nothing is the correct default, and binding one is a deliberate, recorded, human act.
